detailZones.title: Entry door hardware
detailZones.description: Trace the visible entry-door frame, hinges, latch pieces, window, rails and threshold trim.

detailZones.title: Forward galley
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible galley cabinets, oven fronts, carts, coffee equipment, worktop and floor hardware.

detailZones.title: Overhead stowage and passenger service unit
detailZones.translation: 头顶行李架与旅客服务单元
detailZones.description: Study the overhead bin, latches, seams, passenger-service panel, lights, vents and ceiling finish.

detailZones.title: Passenger seating
detailZones.description: Compare the visible forward, middle and rear seat rows, cushions, armrests, tables and fittings.

detailZones.title: Aisle and floor finish
detailZones.description: Follow the central aisle, carpet boundaries, floor joints, seat tracks and partition edges.

detailZones.title: Lavatory interior
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible lavatory doorway, vanity, sink, faucet, mirror, toilet and surface hardware.

detailZones.title: Doorway and fuselage side
detailZones.description: Trace the visible right-hand doorway jamb, latch housing, grab rail, sill and fuselage panel seams.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 aircraft-cabin photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 142 independently pointable entry-door, galley, overhead-service, seating, aisle, lavatory and doorway-side parts. Flight status, passenger actions, airline identity, readable signs, safety outcomes and hidden aircraft systems were excluded.
